name: row insertion with bumping
mechanism: insert each element of a sequence into the first row of a growing tableau, bumping the smallest larger entry down to the next row and repeating, recording where growth happened in a second tableau, giving a bijection from permutations to pairs of tableaux

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Schensted algorithm' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Sequence permutations: constructs a pair of Young tableaux from a permutation
